info.title: Carrie On queued-instruction edit
info.description: Contract for the queued-instruction action; other local API endpoints are outside this document.

post.summary: Edit a waiting enrollment without changing its reset deadline
post.description: Requires the exact enrollment UUID and the previously read instruction. A repeated identical edit succeeds. Conflicting edits, missing enrollments, and sending or attention states are rejected. No model access is needed. After a lost reply, reread /api/status to determine the saved state. The server requires a loopback Host and rejects foreign Origin or cross-site requests.

chat.description: Enrollment ID from /api/status; not the chat ID.

200.description: Saved enrollment, with all fields except prompt preserved.

400.description: Invalid input, missing enrollment, conflicting instruction, or non-waiting state. No edit was made.

503.description: Storage or service failure; reread status before retrying.
